## Initializing Departments
```{r departments}
departments = c("Accountancy", "Economics", "Entrepreneurship", "Finance", "Information Systems & Analytics", "Marketing", "Management")

department_urls = c(
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Accountancy/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Economics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Entrepreneurship/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Finance/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Marketing/all",
  "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Management/all"
)
```

## Scraping Faculty Information
```{r}
faculty <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(departments)) {
  webpage = rvest::read_html(department_urls[i])
  
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> dept
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(3) a") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> positions # Returns both name and position
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(3) a") |> rvest::html_attr("href") -> websites
  
  positions = stringr::str_replace_all(positions, "(?<=[a-z,])(?=[A-Z])", " ") # Separates line breaks - used AI to assist with this step
  positions = stringr::str_remove(positions, names) 
  positions = stringr::str_remove(positions, "ee.*$") # Removes the ee*uniqueid at the end of their position
  positions = stringr::str_squish(positions) # Keeps just position
  
  temp = data.frame(
    department = dept,
    name = names,
    position = positions,
    website = websites
  )
  
  faculty = rbind(faculty, temp)
}

faculty = faculty |>
  dplyr::filter(department %in% departments) # Filters out departments not in list, like FYIC, Office of the Dean, etc.

head(faculty)

```
